What will it take for Indian motorsport to reach the global stage?
From lowering barriers to entry and building a stronger grassroots ecosystem to bringing Formula 1 back to India, the FIA Vice President for Asia-Pacific shares his vision for the future of motorsport in the region.
He also discusses the role of FMSCI, opportunities for aspiring Indian racers and why taking the leap to compete in Europe is crucial for reaching the top
